provenance.method: Rigid frame/TCP calibration matching the official GraspGenX Robotiq open collision envelope to the vendored Gazebo Robotiq open collision envelope
provenance.grasp_origin_note: The normalized GraspNet +X/+Y/+Z axes are approach/closing/binormal. The official pose origin is the GraspGenX Robotiq base. Gazebo's Robotiq base joint is 6 mm forward of link_7; the additional 0.5 mm is a fixed mesh-envelope registration term, not a task or candidate offset. gripper_tip_position_xyz remains separate contact evidence.
provenance.registration_note: At the declared transform the Gazebo leading collision surface is 0.228459 mm behind the GraspGenX collision envelope, covering mesh discretization while preserving the model terminal pose.
provenance.orientation_policy: Preserve every candidate rotation; no fixed wrist orientation or pose preview is permitted.

candidate_status.reason: Scoped to the isolated Gazebo RM75/Robotiq acceptance until physical validation gates pass.
candidate_status.intended_use: GraspGenX grasp-frame to RM75 gripper_mount_link compilation in the pick-place simulator.
